executive_summary: The vendor's proposal completely disregards fundamental client constraints by proposing an unauthorized and unwanted database migration away from PostgreSQL, introducing massive scope creep with unrequested AI modules, and offering an unrealistic 8-week timeline that contradicts the required 6-month structured phased rollout. Although the budget of €98,000 fits within the €80,000–€120,000 range, the severe non-compliance with technical constraints and core methodology makes this proposal unacceptable.
strengths: The proposed total cost of €98,000 falls comfortably within the client's budget range of €80,000–€120,000.
The vendor demonstrates strong technical capability in modern cloud architecture and advanced analytics.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Direct violation of the strict client constraint to integrate with the existing PostgreSQL database without migration.
Severe scope creep introducing unrequested AI predictive analytics and supplier performance scoring.
Unrealistic 8-week delivery timeline that contradicts the required 6-month phased rollout and pilot phase.
Complete omission of required role-based access control (RBAC) details, data migration plans, support SLAs, and documentation of assumptions and risks.

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Vendor proposes a web-based real-time dashboard across all 6 warehouses, though bundled with unnecessary AI features.
Vendor explicitly violates the technical constraint by recommending migration away from the existing PostgreSQL database to their proprietary cloud platform.
Vendor's proposal completely lacks any mention of role-based access control or site-specific permissions for warehouse managers vs HQ staff.
Vendor includes real-time alerts across all locations simultaneously, though lacks threshold configuration specifics.
Vendor proposes a destructive full platform migration instead of an onboarding and rollout plan matching the 6-month phased requirement.
Vendor mentions 'one year of support' is included in the pricing, but provides zero details on response times or SLAs.

scorecard.requirement_title: Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks
scorecard.evaluation_notes: No documentation of assumptions, operational limitations, or project risks is provided in the proposal.
